fact: The Makerere Innovation and Incubation Center is stated to provide mentorship, research support and business development to technology startups, with no cohort programme described, as it launched Fintech Fridays with Afriventia Group.
We Are Tech Africa says the state established the National ICT Innovation Hub, providing internet connectivity and workspace for tech entrepreneurs, with no programme or cohort described.
The Ministry of ICT and National Guidance says it held a graduation ceremony on 11 July 2025 at the National ICT Innovation Hub in Nakawa; no programme for startups is stated.
